title: Made 11 battle stages for my auto battler, can't decide which ones to keep. Vote by number
author: EngineeringBoth976
selftext:
Working on a dumb little auto battler. All the backgrounds are 3-layer parallax (sky / rocks / floor), video shows all 15 with 5 sec each, number in the corner.

I can't tell anymore which ones work, I've been staring at them too long. Which ones would you keep? And tell me if any of them are too busy (or too colorful) behind the fighters, that's the thing I'm paranoid about.

Nano banana pro for the layers + chroma key stuff if anyone cares.

comments.author: KhaosPT
comments.body: They look good but the scale is off from the backgrounds to the characters IMO

replies.author: EngineeringBoth976
replies.body: I think the floor tiles especially, should be more dense

comments.author: Panquax
comments.body: They all Look awesome. I would keep all if they fit The theme. Overall characters Look great too, gj!

comments.author: the_builder_ai
comments.body:
1 columns are busy. 3 is too busy. 8,9,11 are great.

Others are fine - mostly 1 and 3 too busy in background
